perm.exact: Alarms are not allowed – without the “Alarms & reminders” permission nothing will ring.
perm.fullscreen: Full-screen alarms are not allowed – the alarm rings but won't appear over the lock screen.
wecker.per_shift_intro: Switch on: the app wakes you on every day with this shift and adjusts by itself to vacations, swaps or a new pattern. Tap the time to change it.
wecker.single_hint: To set an alarm for just one day, tap that day in the Plan.
wecker.skip_holidays: Skip shift alarms on public holidays
wecker.state_none_due: On – no alarm due right now
wecker.state_no_free_days: On – no unassigned days on the selected weekdays
wecker.state_no_shift_days: On – no {shift} days in the pattern
wecker.toast_off: {name}: automatic alarms removed (manually set ones stay)
wecker.toast_no_free_days: Your pattern has no unassigned days on the selected weekdays
wecker.toast_no_shift_days: Your pattern has no {name} days – add them under Shift plan first
wecker.toast_none_due: {name}: automatic on – no alarm due right now
free.title: Alarm for unassigned days
free.intro: For days without an entry in your pattern (e. g. free weekends), only on the selected weekdays and never on public holidays. The switch works as above: on = automatic for the next 12 months.
behavior.title: Alarm behaviour
behavior.pre_hint: The pre-alarm rings additionally before every automatically set shift alarm.
ringtone.title: Ringtone
ringtone.hint: Choose your own ringtone from your files or use the Android default.
check.title: Check
check.hint: The test alarm rings in 15 seconds – best try it once with the screen locked.
time.title: Alarm time
time.hint: Tap the time to open the clock
start.title: Start week
start.label_kw: Week 1 of your pattern starts in
pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.intro: Set up your shift pattern. It repeats automatically from the start week.
pattern.brush_hint: {shift} selected: tap a day to set {shift}, tap it again to clear it. Tap the legend again to end the selection.
pattern.tip: Tip: tap {shifts} in the legend, then fill days with a single tap.
holidays.title: German public holidays
exceptions.title: Vacation & exceptions
exceptions.hint: On these days the pattern doesn't apply and no automatic alarm rings. Quicker in the Plan: tap a day.
exceptions.end_before: End date is before start date!
backup.title: Backup & export
backup.hint: Saves shift plan, exceptions, alarm times and settings to a file – e. g. for a new phone or as a backup. When loading, the alarms are set again automatically.
backup.ics_hint: “Export calendar” creates an .ics file with your shifts for the next 12 months – e. g. for Google Calendar (there: Settings → Import).
profile.too_new: This profile comes from a newer app version.

wiz.s1_title: In which week does your pattern start?
wiz.s1_sub: Choose the calendar week that is week 1 of your shift pattern.
wiz.s2_title: What does your pattern look like?
wiz.s2_sub: Pick a template as a quick start and adjust it below.
wiz.tpl.fs.name: Early/Late, alternating weekly
wiz.tpl.fs.desc: 2 weeks: Mon–Fri early, then Mon–Fri late
wiz.tpl.fsn.name: Early/Late/Night
wiz.tpl.leer.name: Empty – fill in yourself
wiz.tpl.leer.desc: Clear all days and tap below
wiz.s3_sub: One alarm time for each shift in your pattern.
wiz.auto_hint: “wake automatically” sets alarms for all matching days of the next 12 months and keeps them up to date.
wiz.empty_pattern: Your pattern is still empty. You can set alarms later in the ⏰ Alarms section.
wiz.s4_title: Which German state do you work in?
wiz.s4_sub: So that public holidays show up in the calendar.
wiz.apply_hint: “Set up” applies your plan and alarms.
wiz.done_sub: Your shift plan is set up.
wiz.tip: 🔔 Tip: In the ⏰ Alarms section you can trigger a test alarm – so you hear right away how your alarm sounds.
wiz.later: You can change everything later in the Alarms and Shift plan sections – or via “Start setup” there.

native.fullscreen.message: To show the alarm full screen even when the screen is locked, the app needs the “Full-screen notifications” permission. Without it the alarm still rings, but only appears as a notification.
